basis: US advertised prices reviewed against official pages; not checkout, renewal or installed-device verification. Taxes may apply. Recheck before buying.

products.name: Apple Screen Time
products.coverage: App and website activity reports, time limits, content restrictions and supported communication safeguards.
products.limits: Not a parent-readable transcript of every conversation. Menus and features vary by OS. Screen Time has no general VPN-toggle lock.

products.name: Google Family Link
products.devices: Supported child Android and Chromebook devices
products.coverage: App approvals, usage reports, supported time and content controls, selected notifications and location.
products.limits: A parent iPhone app does not supervise a child iPhone. Supervision does not automatically stop at 13; current under-18 stop-supervision rules require parent approval. Location needs a connected, active device.

products.name: Microsoft Family Safety
products.billing: No mandatory Microsoft 365 subscription for core controls
products.devices: Windows, Xbox and supported Android features
products.coverage: Activity reports, Windows/Xbox device limits and supported app/game limits. Web filtering uses Microsoft Edge.
products.limits: Other browsers must be restricted for web enforcement. Parent iOS management is not child iOS monitoring. Do not assume location or drive-safety features.

products.name: Qustodio
products.billing: Annual billing; advertised card prices before optional promotion codes. Renewal not verified.
products.devices: Basic: 5 devices · Complete: unlimited family devices
products.coverage: Multi-device rules and reports; supported message monitoring subject to plan and platform. iOS SMS/iMessage content and WhatsApp/LINE concerning-topic alerts use desktop-assisted sync.
products.limits: iOS collection needs a compatible Mac/Windows computer, initial cable setup, running app and same Wi-Fi; automatic sync is hourly when available, not live away-from-home monitoring. Verify Complete entitlement. Optional Advance removal prevention supports iOS 15–26, not iOS 27+, in reviewed documentation.

products.name: Bark App
products.billing: Monthly or annual subscription. Optional Bark Sync: $6/month or $49/year; App Store subscriber route lists $79 one-time. Renewal not verified.
products.devices: Unlimited children and devices, with platform-specific features
products.coverage: Supported content-risk alerts, web filtering, screen-time tools and location. iOS supported content scans are separate from filtering.
products.limits: iOS device-content monitoring needs a supported scan method such as an existing compatible desktop or optional Bark Sync. Sync can scan on Wi-Fi away from home; alerts are delayed, not instantaneous. Not every social app or message is supported. Verify the current monitoring matrix.

products.name: Canopy
products.billing: Billed annually. Rounded advertised equivalents, not monthly payments or verified annual invoice totals. Renewal not verified.
products.devices: Essential: 1 · Plus: up to 3 · Premium: up to 10
products.coverage: Supported explicit web-content filtering and separate saved-photo sexting alerts; capabilities vary by OS and permissions.
products.limits: Not universal in-app message monitoring. Private/encrypted folders are excluded from saved-photo scans. iOS Removal Prevention requires separate setup; default alerts do not prevent removal. Do not equate VPN-attributed traffic with additional data use.

products.name: Net Nanny
products.billing: Limited-time annual sale; renewal not verified
products.coverage: Web filtering, supported time controls, location and reports; a conditional alternative, not our default.
products.limits: Official support currently excludes Android, Kindle Fire and Chromebook. Published Mac support ends at 11.x; confirm newer OS support before buying. The single-desktop license is not an iPhone license.

products.name: eero Plus
products.coverage: Network content filters, scheduling and activity history, with bundled services. Free eero profiles and pause controls may already be enough.
products.limits: Home-network filters do not automatically follow devices onto cellular. Bundled privacy VPN is not equivalent to off-network parental filtering.

products.name: TP-Link HomeShield
products.billing: Model/account/region dependent; separate Security+ and bundle prices are not required parental-control fees
products.devices: Compatible TP-Link router or Deco hardware
products.coverage: Free basic controls plus optional advanced parental controls on compatible hardware.
products.limits: Confirm features and renewal in the actual app/account. Router controls cover connected traffic, not every app or cellular connection.

products.name: Gryphon
products.price: Confirm hardware and subscription price in current offer/account
products.billing: Hardware and optional Premium separate; no universal annual price verified
products.devices: Compatible Gryphon hardware and supported mobile devices
products.coverage: Home-network controls; current HomeBound+ describes a cloud-based virtual router for supported mobile traffic.
products.limits: AX is presented as earlier-generation recertified hardware. Do not assume a new $299 AX, a fixed Premium price or a tunnel back through a home AX. Confirm generation, availability and actual mobile setup.

products.name: Aura
products.price: Family: observed $20/month equivalent annual promotion; other official copy $32
products.billing: Conflicting seasonal offers; exact annual charge, renewal and feature inclusions require checkout verification
products.devices: Adults/devices depend on the selected offer
products.coverage: Identity and financial alerts, device-security tools and consent-based Trusted Family Access.
products.limits: Not a guarantee against scams. Family access must be granted and can be revoked. Insurance terms, eligibility and exclusions apply; identity coverage is not universal scam reimbursement. Separate cyber-insurance add-on is not assumed included.

products.name: EverSafe
products.price: Essentials $7.49/month or $76.32/year · Plus $16.99 or $173.28 · Gold $26.99 or $275.28
products.billing: Monthly or annual billing; exact renewal changes and annual refund terms not verified
products.devices: Eligible connected financial accounts, not a device filter
products.coverage: Financial anomaly alerts with consent-based Trusted Advocates; plan-dependent credit and investment features.
products.limits: Does not stop every payment or replace a fiduciary. Online account access is required. Sharing transaction/balance details needs explicit designation. Insurance is subject to terms.

products.name: Norton 360 with LifeLock Select
products.billing: Annual introductory offer; official page also labels corresponding offer Select Plus. Confirm exact checkout plan.
products.devices: 10 devices in reviewed offer; feature support varies by OS
products.coverage: Device security, scam-related tools and identity features; combined Norton/LifeLock plan, not standalone LifeLock.
products.limits: Not universal scam reimbursement. Reviewed Select offer distinguishes up to $25,000 identity-theft stolen-funds reimbursement from up to $1M lawyers/experts. Full policy governs. Windows backup and other features have platform limits.
